# Artifactory

The Artifactory category has 2 tasks. Each entry shows the task's latest revision, the one the palette adds. See [Reading an entry](./overview#reading-an-entry).

## Artifactory File Download

Artifactory File Download

- **Slug:** `artifactory-file-download`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 2
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| URL | `url` | Text | Yes |  | The artifact's full URL, e.g. https://acme.jfrog.io/artifactory/libs-release/com/acme/widget/1.0/widget-1.0.jar |
| Destination Path | `destinationPath` | Text | Yes |  | A workspace file or directory, absolute or relative to /workspace. A directory (or a path ending in /) keeps the artifact's name |
| Access Token | `accessToken` | Secured | No |  | A JFrog access token, sent as a Bearer token. Preferred over API Key and Username/Password |
| API Key | `apiKey` | Secured | No |  | An existing JFrog API key; JFrog no longer issues them, so prefer Access Token |
| Username | `username` | Text | No |  | With Password, when there is no Access Token |
| Password | `password` | Secured | No |  | With Username, when there is no Access Token |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | The absolute path of the downloaded file |
| `size` | The file's size in bytes |
| `sha256` | The file's SHA-256, checked against the checksum Artifactory sends |

## Artifactory File Upload

Upload file to Artifactory

- **Slug:** `artifactory-file-upload`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 3
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| URL | `url` | Text | Yes |  | The artifact's full URL, e.g. https://acme.jfrog.io/artifactory/libs-release/com/acme/widget/1.0/widget-1.0.jar |
| File | `file` | Text | Yes |  | The workspace file to upload, absolute or relative to /workspace |
| Access Token | `accessToken` | Secured | No |  | A JFrog access token, sent as a Bearer token. Preferred over API Key and Username/Password |
| API Key | `apiKey` | Secured | No |  | An existing JFrog API key; JFrog no longer issues them, so prefer Access Token |
| Username | `username` | Text | No |  | With Password, when there is no Access Token |
| Password | `password` | Secured | No |  | With Username, when there is no Access Token |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `downloadUri` | The artifact's URL, as Artifactory reports it |
| `sha256` | The file's SHA-256, checked against the checksum Artifactory stored |
| `size` | The file's size in bytes |
